services.name: Charleston Power Yoga
services.desc: Our Mission is to transform our lives and the lives of others through a connection to our breath, our bodies and our soul. We show up to let go, to come back to our true north, and to be reminded of what makes us valuable and unique. We share this practice because we know it works . We are a local, veteran and family owned yoga studio in Mount Pleasant, SC. We are Charleston’s ORIGINAL heated power yoga and Baptiste yoga studio. We keep it real. We move, breathe, sweat and live life together. Hard work, getting real with ourselves, commitment to the journey and the process, not just the results; community; sharing yoga with everyone because yoga can benefit everyone; lifting one another up.

This expertly led class strings postures together so that you move seamlessly from one to another, using your breath. Expect a variety of postures, a great workout and plenty of playful creativity. blurb: Experience Charleston's hottest spot for a heart-pumping, sweat-drenched heated power yoga session! Here, we keep it real, sweaty, and seriously empowering-no fluff, no trends, just pure, unadulterated power. Whether you're a seasoned yogi or brand new to the mat, we've got you covered.
